name: Number bases
description: Convert between decimal, binary, octal and hexadecimal.
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase();const names={binary:2,'base 2':2,base2:2,octal:8,'base 8':8,hex:16,hexadecimal:16,'base 16':16,decimal:10,'base 10':10};let src=null,from=10,to=null;let m;if(m=t.match(/\b0x([0-9a-f]+)\b/)){src=m[1];from=16}else if(m=t.match(/\b0b([01]+)\b/)){src=m[1];from=2}else if(m=t.match(/\b0o([0-7]+)\b/)){src=m[1];from=8}else if(m=t.match(/\b([0-9a-f]+)\s*(?:in|from)?\s*(binary|hex(?:adecimal)?|octal|decimal|base ?\d+)\s*(?:to|into|in|as)\b/)){src=m[1];from=names[m[2].replace(/ +/,' ')]||+m[2].replace(/\D/g,'')}else if(m=t.match(/\b(\d+)\b/)){src=m[1];from=10}const tm=t.match(/(?:to|into|in|as)\s+(binary|hex(?:adecimal)?|octal|decimal|base ?\d+)\s*\??$/)||t.match(/(?:to|into|in|as)\s+(binary|hex(?:adecimal)?|octal|decimal|base ?\d+)/);if(tm)to=names[tm[1].replace(/ +/,' ')]||+tm[1].replace(/\D/g,'');if(to==null)to=from===10?2:10;if(!src)return{answer:null,reason:'No number found.'};const v=parseInt(src,from);if(!Number.isFinite(v))return{answer:null,reason:`“${src}” isn’t valid in base ${from}.`};const out=v.toString(to).toUpperCase(),pre={2:'0b',8:'0o',16:'0x',10:''}[to]||'';return{answer:`${pre}${out}`,steps:[`${src} in base ${from} = ${v} in decimal`,`${v} in base ${to} = ${out}`]}}
